title: Hearing George Baquet with Freddie Keppard
summary: Angrum never heard McCurdy play. He listened to George Baquet in Freddie Keppard's band, praising his low register, and describes Keppard as a big, powerful trumpeter.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: I was going to ask about some of the old times there, Nettis, when you first moved to the city. Did you hear people like Big Eye and Piku and... Yeah. Or was McCurdy around? Do you remember him? I heard of him, but I never heard of him play. I heard of McCurdy. I never heard of him play yet. Did you ever hear George Barquet? Was he hearing when you were in the bar?

Yeah, I haven't heard of Barquet. Barquet used to play with Freddie Kepler. Used to play with Freddie Kepler lots of time. I used to go to dancing. George Barquet was playing. I had to sit right up under the music stand, listen to that man play, crying there. Was he good? He was real good. Right. And he played a whole lot of low register. Low register? Plenty of low register. He'd go up and make them notes, you know, go way up and come down, you know, breathe and just scream, you know, and the way up. Make them pretty, you know. And I'd just sit down under that music stand and listen at it. I'd never go to dance. I'd just sit down and listen at them people play. That's all I used to do is sit and listen at them, you know. No, they'd tell my dancing too much. I used to go to dance near them. Especially if I'd go to a place and a client that was there, man, I'd never was going to dance. You said George Barquet was playing with Freddie Kepler? Yeah. What kind of trumpet player was Freddie Kepler? He was one of them good ones. Was he a good one? Yeah, he was a good one. Freddie Kepler was a trumpet player on all the punch, punch metal. Played something like on punches style. They say he was very powerful. He was powerful. Powerful man. He was big enough. He was a big man? He was a big fella, yeah. About six foot two. Yeah. Weighed about two something. Weighed about two hundred and something.
